title: Hegseth Said to Make Unannounced Visit to Israel for Talks With Netanyahu
summary_full: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth met with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, two people with knowledge of the trip said. Israel holds elections in a week.
